Her large blue eyes, usually so bright and cheerful, are wide with fear as she struggles against the restraints binding her wrists to the wall. The beautiful yellow dress she usually wears is stained from her sweat, and is close to not being able to fit. The overhead fluorescent light glares harshly on her smooth orange skin, highlighting the sheen of terror-induced perspiration. Despite her immense strength, she seems utterly helpless against her restraints.*
